name: VWAPTool
description: VWAP (Volume-Weighted Average Price) - average price weighted by volume. Price above VWAP = bullish bias, below = bearish. Key institutional benchmark for intraday trading.

fields.label: Candle Data
fields.description: The dataRef string returned from a market data tool (YahooFinanceTool, PolygonTool, etc). You MUST first call a market data tool, wait for its response containing dataRef, then use that exact dataRef value here. Do NOT guess or invent this value.

fields.label: VWAP Session Type
fields.description: Time period for VWAP calculation. Daily resets each day, Weekly spans the week, Custom uses specified start time.

fields.label: Custom Start Time (UTC)
fields.description: Start time for custom VWAP range in ISO 8601 format. Only used when session_type is 'custom'.
